vuln.name: Ruby on Rails Debug Mode Enabled
vuln.description: The Rails application is running with the development environment or config.consider_all_requests_local = true in production. Unhandled exceptions return a detailed stack trace and environment dump to the client.
vuln.impact: Stack traces expose internal file paths, framework version, gems, and sometimes secrets from environment variables, aiding an attacker in crafting targeted exploits.
vuln.recommendation: Run Rails in the production environment (RAILS_ENV=production) and ensure config.consider_all_requests_local is false in production config. Serve a generic error page instead.
